    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Tutorials are for People Who Can't Read",
      "goal": "Survive the 'Impossible' tutorial boss by exploiting a clipping error in the arena geometry.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused casualty to a high-level outlier with a broken stat sheet.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arrival in the system's death-trap tutorial.",
        "to_next": "Finding a place to hide and process the loot while the system tries to recalibrate."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Welcome to the Grinder",
          "intent": "Establish the protagonist's arrival in a lethal tutorial and their discovery of the broken arena geometry.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist reaches the threshold of the final tutorial boss arena.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie awakens in a dark, damp spawning pit, realizing he's been isekai'd into a tutorial designed to kill players for 'calibration'.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts his situation and finds a rusted dagger stuck in a skeleton.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_SURVIVAL"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Spawning Pit",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Spawning Pit",
              "location_start": "A cramped, damp stone pit filled with the bones of previous 'failures'.",
              "location_end": "A cramped, damp stone pit filled with the bones of previous 'failures'.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie gasps for air as the system initializes his consciousness against the cold stone floor.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cold damp stone", "blue system notifications", "smell of wet bone"],
              "transition_out_text": "He grips the rusted hilt and pulls, the metal screeching against the skeleton's ribs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["rusted dagger hilt", "hollow eye sockets", "distant mechanical hum"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie faces the first tutorial mob, a skeletal warrior, and notices a visual stutter in its movement that he can exploit.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie kills the skeleton by timing his strike during its animation frame-skip, gaining his first level.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Spawning Pit",
              "location_end_label": "Narrow Corridor",
              "location_start": "A cramped, damp stone pit.",
              "location_end": "A long, dark hallway with flickering torches and uneven paving stones.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The first skeletal warrior drags its feet across the stone, its movements jerky and unnatural.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["jerky bone movements", "flickering torchlight", "the rusted dagger's edge"],
              "transition_out_text": "With the skeleton collapsed into dust, Artie moves deeper into the corridor.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["piles of bone dust", "level up notification", "echoing footsteps"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie navigates the corridor traps, noticing that the 'hitboxes' for the swinging blades are slightly offset from the visual models.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie reaches the boss arena doors, having bypassed all traps without taking damage.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "location_start_label": "Narrow Corridor",
              "location_end_label": "Arena Threshold",
              "location_start": "A long, dark hallway filled with swinging blade traps.",
              "location_end": "The massive, iron-bound double doors leading to the final tutorial encounter.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The blades swing with a rhythmic whistle, but Artie sees the gap where the damage shouldn't be.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["swinging steel blades", "offset shadow hitboxes", "the smell of old oil"],
              "transition_out_text": "He places his hands on the cold iron of the boss doors, bracing for what lies beyond.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["iron-bound doors", "distant boss roar", "the threshold of the arena"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist reaches the threshold of the final tutorial boss arena."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Clipping Point",
          "intent": "Depict the combat encounter where the protagonist exploits a corner seam to avoid damage and kill the boss.",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss dies from falling through the world geometry.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "The Iron Sentinel, a massive mechanical boss, activates. Artie realizes he is vastly underleveled and begins searching for a terrain exploit.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies a jagged corner in the arena wall where the textures don't quite meet.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "location_start_label": "Iron Sentinel Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Iron Sentinel Arena",
              "location_start": "A vast, circular stone arena with high walls and a ceiling lost in shadow.",
              "location_end": "A vast, circular stone arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The doors groan open, revealing a titan of brass and steam standing in the center of the pit.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["brass mechanical limbs", "hissing steam vents", "cracked stone floor"],
              "transition_out_text": "He dives behind a pillar, spotting the flickering seam in the masonry of the northwest corner.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flickering wall textures", "massive brass fist", "shattered stone pillars"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie lures the Iron Sentinel toward the glitched corner, dodging massive AOE attacks that shatter the surrounding pillars.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "The Sentinel is positioned perfectly against the clipping seam.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "location_start_label": "Iron Sentinel Arena",
              "location_end_label": "The Glitched Corner",
              "location_start": "The circular stone arena.",
              "location_end": "A specific corner of the arena where the wall and floor textures overlap poorly.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie taunts the machine, leading it closer to the jagged geometry of the wall.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vibrating floor tiles", "the roar of the sentinel", "jagged corner seam"],
              "transition_out_text": "The boss prepares a heavy overhead smash, its massive weight leaning into the glitched space.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["raised mechanical hammer", "the smell of burning coal", "the shimmering void-line"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "The Iron Sentinel's attack causes its model to clip through the wall. The physics engine panics, and the boss falls into the 'void' beneath the map.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "The boss is deleted by the system, and Artie is awarded massive 'Overkill' and 'Exploit' experience.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "location_start_label": "The Glitched Corner",
              "location_end_label": "Iron Sentinel Arena",
              "location_start": "The specific corner of the arena.",
              "location_end": "The now-silent, empty arena floor.",
              "handoff_mode": "aftermath_relocation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The hammer falls, not hitting the floor, but sinking into the wall as the Sentinel's legs vanish.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["screeching metal physics", "the boss's falling scream", "flashing error messages"],
              "transition_out_text": "Silence returns to the arena, broken only by the rapid-fire 'ding' of level-up notifications.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["cascading gold level-ups", "empty boss platform", "the smell of ozone"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss dies from falling through the world geometry."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Looting the Void",
          "intent": "Show the protagonist gathering high-level drops from the glitched kill and finding the exit.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist steps through the exit portal into the main world.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie loots the 'impossible' drops that spawned where the boss clipped out, including a legendary-tier ring and a massive pile of gold.",
              "type": "resolution",
              "outcome": "Artie equips the 'Ring of the Void-Walker' and prepares to leave.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "location_start_label": "Iron Sentinel Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Arena Center",
              "location_start": "The empty arena floor.",
              "location_end": "The center of the arena where a glowing loot chest has appeared.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A shimmering chest materializes where the Sentinel last stood before the world swallowed it.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shimmering loot chest", "the Ring of the Void-Walker", "piles of gold coins"],
              "transition_out_text": "He slides the ring onto his finger, feeling a strange chill as a portal opens in the distance.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["glowing exit portal", "the weight of the gold", "the chill of the ring"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie approaches the exit portal, ignoring the system's frantic attempts to issue a 'correction' for the tutorial anomalies.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie exits the tutorial and enters the world of Criticulous.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "location_start_label": "Arena Center",
              "location_end_label": "The Great Beyond",
              "location_start": "The center of the boss arena.",
              "location_end": "A swirling blue portal that leads out of the tutorial instance.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The red warning text flickers across his vision, but the blue portal is faster.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["swirling blue light", "red system warnings", "the final step forward"],
              "transition_out_text": "He steps into the light, leaving the broken tutorial behind for good.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blinding white light", "the sound of wind", "the feeling of weightlessness"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist steps through the exit portal into the main world."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Luck is a Valid Skill Tree",
      "goal": "Dump all attribute points into Luck and find a starting town that won't arrest a 'glitch' on sight.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From accidental survivor to intentional system-breaker.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Escaping the tutorial zone with unintended rewards.",
        "to_next": "Identifying a high-value target that only a high-luck build can reach."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Statistical Anomalies",
          "intent": "The protagonist analyzes their broken rewards and decides to dump all points into Luck.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist confirms the final stat point allocation into Luck.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie arrives in a peaceful meadow outside the tutorial exit. He opens his character sheet to see the massive XP dump from the boss kill.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he has 50 unallocated attribute points.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_LUCK_BUILD"],
              "location_start_label": "The Great Beyond",
              "location_end_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_start": "A swirling blue portal.",
              "location_end": "A lush, green meadow with distant mountains and a clear blue sky.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The light fades, and Artie finds himself face-down in the softest grass he's ever felt.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["vibrant green grass", "the smell of clover", "floating blue UI window"],
              "transition_out_text": "He scrolls through his stats, his eyes widening at the number of points available.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["unallocated stat points", "level 25 notification", "the distant sound of a stream"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie debates his build. He considers Strength or Agility, but then notices the hidden 'Luck' multiplier on his Ring of the Void-Walker.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie decides to commit to a 100% Luck build to maximize the 'glitch' potential.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "location_start_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_start": "A lush, green meadow.",
              "location_end": "A lush, green meadow.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He sits up, leaning against a tree as he taps the shimmering ring on his finger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rough tree bark", "the shimmering ring", "stat allocation screen"],
              "transition_out_text": "He hovers his finger over the Luck stat, a grin spreading across his face.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the Luck attribute", "a risky decision", "the golden UI glow"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie dumps all 50 points into Luck. The system stutters, and he receives a title: 'The Improbable Outcome'.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie's Luck stat hits a level that shouldn't be possible for a starting player.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "location_start_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_start": "A lush, green meadow.",
              "location_end": "A lush, green meadow.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He taps the '+' button repeatedly until the counter hits fifty.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["the confirm button", "a flash of gold light", "the new title notification"],
              "transition_out_text": "The world feels slightly different now, as if the wind is blowing specifically to cool him down.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the 'Improbable Outcome' title", "a gentle breeze", "the smell of success"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist confirms the final stat point allocation into Luck."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Long Walk to Town",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the immediate effects of high Luck during a dangerous journey to the first settlement.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist arrives at the gates of the starting town, Oakhaven.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie starts walking toward the nearest road. He trips over a rock, which turns out to be a buried treasure chest.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie gains a high-quality leather cloak and some rare herbs.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "location_start_label": "The Sunlit Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "Edge of the Woods",
              "location_start": "A lush, green meadow.",
              "location_end": "The beginning of a dense forest with a dirt path winding through it.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He sets off toward the tree line, his boots crunching on the grass.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["a loose stone", "the sound of wood splintering", "a buried iron lock"],
              "transition_out_text": "He shakes the dirt off the new cloak and drapes it over his shoulders.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["fine leather cloak", "bundles of silverleaf", "the deepening forest"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "A group of low-level bandits attempts to ambush Artie. Before they can attack, a nearby beehive falls on them.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "The bandits flee, and Artie loots the gold they dropped in their panic.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "location_start_label": "Edge of the Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Forest Path",
              "location_start": "The beginning of a dense forest.",
              "location_end": "A narrow dirt path surrounded by thick undergrowth.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Three men step out from behind the trees, brandishing rusty swords.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rusty bandit swords", "the buzzing of bees", "a snapping branch"],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie whistles a tune as he picks up the leather pouches left in the dirt.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["scattered copper coins", "the sound of retreating screams", "the smell of honey"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie finds a rare 'Merchant's Map' stuck in a bush, showing secret paths to the town of Oakhaven.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers a shortcut that avoids the main guard checkpoints.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "location_start_label": "Forest Path",
              "location_end_label": "Hidden Shortcut",
              "location_start": "A narrow dirt path.",
              "location_end": "A barely visible trail through a thicket of thorns that leads to a ridge.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The wind catches a piece of parchment, pinning it against a thorn bush right in his path.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["parchment map", "thorn bush", "ink markings"],
              "transition_out_text": "He follows the map's instructions, stepping off the main road and into the brush.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the hidden trail", "distant town bells", "the smell of pine needles"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie reaches the ridge overlooking Oakhaven. He sees the town gates and the heavy guard presence.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the town gates as his next destination.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "location_start_label": "Hidden Shortcut",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Gates",
              "location_start": "A barely visible trail.",
              "location_end": "The massive wooden gates of Oakhaven, flanked by stone towers.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He crests the hill, and the town of Oakhaven spreads out below him like a toy set.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["wooden gate towers", "the sound of a blacksmith", "rising chimney smoke"],
              "transition_out_text": "He adjusts his cloak, hiding his face as he descends toward the main entrance.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the town gates", "the heavy iron portcullis", "the sound of a horn"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist arrives at the gates of the starting town, Oakhaven."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Blending In (Poorly)",
          "intent": "Establish a temporary identity and find a place to lay low while avoiding system-enforced 'corrections'.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist secures a room at a local inn under a false name.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie enters Oakhaven. The guards are distracted by a sudden merchant cart accident, allowing him to slip through without being scanned.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the town without a formal registration.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Gates",
              "location_end_label": "Market Square",
              "location_start": "The massive wooden gates of Oakhaven.",
              "location_end": "A bustling square filled with stalls, shoppers, and street performers.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "A wheel snaps on a cabbage cart just as Artie reaches the guard station.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["shouting guards", "rolling cabbages", "the shadow of the gate"],
              "transition_out_text": "He blends into the crowd of the market square, his heart hammering against his ribs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the smell of roasted meat", "the noise of the market", "the colorful stall awnings"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie looks for an inn. He overhears a guard talking about a 'glitch' in the tutorial and realizes the System is looking for him.",
              "type": "exposition",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he needs a fake name and a place to hide immediately.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "location_start_label": "Market Square",
              "location_end_label": "The Glitched Goblet Inn",
              "location_start": "A bustling square.",
              "location_end": "A slightly run-down but cozy inn with a crooked sign.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "transition_in_text": "He lingers by a fountain, catching the sharp words of two armored men passing by.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["the fountain's spray", "the guards' conversation", "the crooked inn sign"],
              "transition_out_text": "He ducks into the doorway of the inn, the bell chiming softly above him.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the chime of the bell", "the smell of stale ale", "the dim interior light"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"

              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie checks into 'The Glitched Goblet'. He uses the name 'Lucky' and pays for a week in advance with his tutorial gold.",
              "type": "resolution",
              "outcome": "Artie has a safe house and a new alias.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "location_start_label": "The Glitched Goblet Inn",
              "location_end_label": "Artie's Room",
              "location_start": "The main taproom of the inn.",
              "location_end": "A small, clean room with a bed, a desk, and a window overlooking an alley.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "sheltered",
              "transition_in_text": "The innkeeper looks up from a ledger, squinting at Artie through thick spectacles.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["the innkeeper's ledger", "the heavy gold coin", "the name 'Lucky'"],
              "transition_out_text": "He locks the door to his new room and finally lets out a long, shaky breath.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["the heavy iron key", "the wooden bed frame", "the view of the alley"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist secures a room at a local inn under a false name."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "The Unbreakable Vault is Actually a Suggestion",
      "goal": "Infiltrate the local Merchant Guild's 'impenetrable' storage using a combination of high crit-rate and bad physics.",
      "chapter_role": "investigation",
      "stakes_shift": "From a petty nuisance to a high-priority target for the local authorities.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Entering the trade hub under a false identity.",
        "to_next": "A massive bounty is placed on the 'Ghost of the Vault' leading to a chase."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 12
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
